scope: exploratory explicit measurement-port adapter; fixed cell electrochemistry; preserve unadapted AVL failures
training: first300s of 0.7C alternating-current module test; regress measured AVL_V minus measured BMS_V on constant and charge-positive AVL current; no simulator residual enters adapter fit
adapter: V_AVL_prediction=6*V_cell_prediction+offset_V+R_effective_ohm*I_AVL; require abs(offset)<=0.5V and0<=R<=0.02ohm; no physical identification claim for leads or contact resistance
initialization: invert frozen cell OCV against pre-pulse BMS summed voltage/6; SOC in[0,1]; initial temperature mean of nine thermocouples on cell4
selection: first sample with AVL_I<-10A, five prior quiet samples absI<=1A, negative peak within next12 samples exceeds0.8*132*named_Crate, followed by positive peak within samples8..24 exceeding same threshold; this selects alternating protocol after preparation, not first activity in file
solvers: SPMe and DFN mesh40,90s each; actual measured current, isothermal initial cell4 surface temperature
exposure: all files are previously exposed development data; 1C result already seen; stage1.2C selected by input-only protocol; NOT blind or confirmatory
limits: no full MCCC/fast-charge/thermal qualification; no reserved payloads; temperaturesandstates assumedhomogeneous
freeze: publish adapter values, code and protocol hashes before new model predictions; no further fit after evaluation
